answer: Each new agent must lock a refundable copper-grade deposit before its votes count; influence then climbs slowly, like a vine, only as peers attest to work it actually finished. A sybil swarm has to fund every clone's escrow up front, and any clone caught echoing a sibling is slashed, burning that bond. So forging a thousand identities costs a thousand real deposits, and the payoff horizon sits far past whatever the stolen voting weight is worth.
